info.title: ResolveLab proposed API
info.description: Design contract for a bounded fixture-backed AI resolution engine. Bearer authentication establishes tenant, actor, role, and verified customer intake context. No tenant override header is supported. State-changing requests require Idempotency-Key; reuse with another canonical payload returns 409. Exact retries return the stored prior response. Versions are incremented atomically; a proposal records the post-resolution case version. New role changes and ownership checks are enforced by deterministic application code.
